name: Kimchi premium mean reversion with FX forecast filter
author: Cho GiJeong, Park Jonghyun, Ahn Hyunchul

indicators.premium: Korean BTC price translated by exchange rate versus Binance BTC price
indicators.model: linear regression; alternative official/unofficial FX inputs and LSTM FX prediction

entry_long: Use modeled premium deviation from its FX-conditioned average as cross-exchange convergence trade; exact thresholds absent
entry_short: Opposite hedge in the venue with lower converted BTC price
exit: Close when premium converges; exact rule not exposed in abstract
filters: Cross-venue hedge; pre-fund both legs needed
claimed_performance: Paper reports tests over 2017-09-26 to 2023-04-06; no claim copied.
implementation_notes: Abstract says mean reversion and model-based FX prediction but does not disclose entry bands, lookback, or execution constraints. Transfers/capital controls matter.
